# The Scheduler and Timeline guides run their first example in place

## Context

Engine 14's cornerstone #20874 promises each new family "a runnable example and a guide". The learn section has 87 live previews on 31 pages (the #21870 lane ran all of them), and none in the four family guides: `Scheduler.md`, `Timeline.md`, `Board.md` and `Gantt.md` show their opening example as static code, though the Scheduler guide calls it "a complete, runnable scheduler" and the Timeline guide "a minimal, runnable `Viewport.mjs`".

## The Problem

A reader of the Scheduler or Timeline guide has to leave the page, find `examples/`, and run it to see the code they just read. The opening example of each is already complete and self-contained, so the Portal's live preview could run it beside the text.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.code.LivePreview` runs a ```` ```javascript live-preview ```` block through `Neo.code.executor.Neo`, which turns each import into a dynamic `import()` and rebases relative paths from `src/code/` (`'../scheduler/Container.mjs'`), and maps `export default` to the preview's module.
- Both opening blocks import only from `src/` and end in `export default Neo.setupClass(MainViewport)`.
- `Board.md` and `Gantt.md` are being edited by open pull requests (#21873, #21898, #21922), so they wait for those to merge. `WebDesktops.md`'s first block imports sibling files (`./Calculator.mjs`), so it cannot run standalone.

## The Fix

`Scheduler.md` and `Timeline.md`: the opening block becomes `javascript live-preview` with imports in the preview convention, and the sentence before it tells the reader to open Preview.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Both previews render in the Portal on the branch: the scheduler's studios, time axis and bookings; the timeline's three resources and their events.
- [ ] AC-2: `npm run check-relative-links` stays OK.

## Out of Scope

- `Board.md` and `Gantt.md` (open pull requests on both; a follow-up once they merge).
- `WebDesktops.md` (its example spans several files).
- The other code blocks of both guides, which are excerpts.
